column1: # The baseline scan runs against the app served over plain HTTP on localhost,
# so header/transport findings that only make sense on a public HTTPS host are
# ignored here. Security-relevant findings (CSP, clickjacking, cookie flags,
# X-Content-Type-Options, SameSite, debug errors) are intentionally left active
# so they still surface in the report.
